id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting admin shutdown queue db disconnects to error tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion recovery by distinguishing PostgreSQL AdminShutdown errors from transient failures, potentially reducing unnecessary alerts and aiding self-healing.
review.reason: Adds a helper function to distinguish PostgreSQL AdminShutdown errors from other connection failures, supporting warehouse ingestion recovery without unnecessary alerting.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the warehouse ingestion consumers actually utilizing this distinction; the implementation is present but the operational outcome is not independently verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, so no score is returned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function to distinguish PostgreSQL AdminShutdown errors from other connection failures.
observations.code_quote: # Same self-healing admin-initiated disconnect, but hit by the periodic recovery
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion consumers to recognize when a database connection is terminated by an administrator command rather than a transient network or application error, supporting recovery without unnecessary alerting.
